from pathlib import Path
import ast, copy, hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, zipfile
from unittest import mock
ROOT=Path('/tmp/ai-gpu-serial-20261121')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'ci/project'))
import p06_contract as c
import p06_replay as replay
import p06_analyze as analyze
import p06_execute as runner
import p04_model_contract as model
import p02_fixture_oracle as leaf
BASE='5da357f0f4a3cd3581919b35941db7a07d0d9fbe'
OUT=Path('/tmp/w06-a06-probe.json')
REVIEWED=['ci/project/p06_contract.py','ci/project/p06_replay.py','ci/project/p06_analyze.py','ci/project/p06_execute.py','ci/project/p06_test_frozen_sources.py','ci/project/p06_test_packets.py','ci/project/p06_test_samples.py','ci/project/test_p06_contract.py','ci/project/test_p06_records.py','ci/project/test_p06_timing.py','ci/project/test_p06_runner.py','ci/project/test_p06_replay.py','ci/project/test_p06_ci_contract.py','ci/project/test_p06_replay_ci.py','.github/workflows/p06-baseline.yml','ci/project/p06_benchmark_contract.json','ci/project/p04_model_contract.py','ci/project/p04_fixture_adapter.py','ci/project/p02_wmma_fixtures.py','docs/project/evidence/p05-torch/reviews/archive_reader.py','docs/project/evidence/p06-baseline/acceptance.json','docs/project/evidence/p06-baseline/archive-index.json','docs/project/evidence/p06-baseline/reviews/analysis.json','docs/review/code-review-policy.md']
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
identities=lambda:[dict(path=p,sha256=sha((ROOT/p).read_bytes()),bytes=(ROOT/p).stat().st_size) for p in REVIEWED]
report={'scope':'independent-migration-boundary-probe','baseline':BASE,'native_execution':False,'source_before':identities(),'checks':[]}
start=time.monotonic()
def check(name,**data):
    report['checks'].append(dict(check=name,**data));OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(name,flush=True)
def expect_error(fn, expected):
    try:fn()
    except ValueError as e:
        if expected not in str(e): raise AssertionError((expected,str(e)))
        return str(e)
    raise AssertionError('expected rejection: '+expected)
def encode(x):return (json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
def describe(path,body):return dict(path=path,sha256=sha(body),size_bytes=len(body))
manifest=c.load_analysis_contract(ROOT)
original_contract=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',BASE+':ci/project/p06_contract.py'],cwd=ROOT)
def literal(tree,name):
    for n in ast.parse(tree).body:
        if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id==name for t in n.targets):return ast.literal_eval(n.value)
    raise AssertionError(name)
assert literal(original_contract,'_SOURCE_HASHES')==c._SOURCE_HASHES
assert len(c._SOURCE_HASHES)==46 and len(c.ANALYSIS_SOURCE_PATHS)==21 and len(c._ANALYSIS_HELPERS)==7
for path,module in c._ANALYSIS_HELPERS:
    assert Path(module.__file__).absolute()==ROOT/path and sha((ROOT/path).read_bytes())==c._SOURCE_HASHES[path]
check('analysis-current-accepted-strict-current-rejected',analysis_pins=21,helper_pins=7,execution_pins=46,reason=expect_error(lambda:c.load_contract(ROOT),'frozen source input differs: sw/runtime/ai/mlp_runtime.cpp'))
index=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/project/evidence/p06-baseline/archive-index.json').read_text())
archives={row['format']:row for row in index['archives']}
for row in archives.values():assert sha((ROOT/row['path']).read_bytes())==row['sha256']
# Read trusted original members as immutable bytes; never extract/import any.
with zipfile.ZipFile(ROOT/archives['fp16']['path']) as z:
    assert len(z.namelist())==len(set(z.namelist()))
    members={name:z.read(name) for name in z.namelist()}
original_report=json.loads(members['baseline/report.json'])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='w06-a06-independent-') as td:
    tmp=Path(td);source=tmp/'source';source.mkdir()
    needed=set(c._SOURCE_HASHES)|set(model.ARTIFACT_PATHS)|{c.MANIFEST_PATH,leaf.JSON_PATH.as_posix()}
    for relative in sorted(needed):
        dst=source/relative;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        member='baseline/artifacts/source/'+relative
        dst.write_bytes(members[member] if member in members else (ROOT/relative).read_bytes())
    assert c.load_contract(source)==manifest
    assert c.load_analysis_contract(source)==manifest
    tamper=[]
    for relative in c.ANALYSIS_SOURCE_PATHS:
        path=source/relative;body=path.read_bytes();path.write_bytes(body+b'\n')
        reason=expect_error(lambda:c.load_analysis_contract(source),'frozen source input differs: '+relative)
        assert path.read_bytes()==body+b'\n';path.write_bytes(body)
        tamper.append(dict(path=relative,rejection=reason))
    check('all-analysis-input-tampering-rejected',count=len(tamper),cases=tamper)
    omitted=set(c._SOURCE_HASHES)-set(c.ANALYSIS_SOURCE_PATHS)
    bodies={relative:(source/relative).read_bytes() for relative in omitted}
    for relative in omitted:(source/relative).unlink()
    assert c.load_analysis_contract(source)==manifest
    for relative,body in bodies.items():(source/relative).write_bytes(body)
    check('analysis-independent-of-execution-only-files',omitted_files=sorted(omitted),count=len(omitted))
    # Independent runner guard probe: only resource and checkout observations are
    # synthetic. The loader, file hashing and runner control flow remain real.
    for item in runner.LOADED_HELPERS:
        dst=source/item['path'];dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dst.write_bytes((ROOT/item['path']).read_bytes())
    native=[]
    for i,relative in enumerate(('sw/runtime/ai/runtime.cpp','sw/runtime/ai/runtime.h','sw/runtime/ai/mlp_runtime.cpp')):
        target=source/relative;body=target.read_bytes();target.write_bytes((ROOT/relative).read_bytes())
        attempt=tmp/('native-'+str(i));attempt.mkdir();tools=attempt/'tools';tools.mkdir()
        paths=dict(source=source,work=attempt/'work',output=attempt/'output',tools=tools,host_bin=None,verilator=tools/'verilator')
        args=runner.argument_parser().parse_args(['run','--tools-dir',str(tools),'--work-dir',str(paths['work']),'--output',str(paths['output']),'--format','fp16'])
        resources={'available_memory_bytes':runner.BUDGET['max_rss_bytes'],'free_disk_bytes':{k:runner.BUDGET['min_free_bytes'] for k in ('source','tools','work','output')}}
        snapshot={'checkout':{'revision':'1'*40,'tree':'2'*40,'dirty':False,'blockers':[]},'files':runner.hash_artifacts(source,sorted(c._SOURCE_HASHES))}
        with mock.patch.object(runner.base,'_resources',return_value=resources),mock.patch.object(runner,'source_snapshot',return_value=snapshot),mock.patch.object(runner,'run_bounded',side_effect=AssertionError('process must not run')) as process:
            result=runner.execute(args,paths)
            process.assert_not_called()
        assert result['outcome']=='blocked' and result['commands']==[] and result['samples']==[]
        assert result['reason']=='frozen source input differs: '+relative,result['reason']
        native.append(dict(path=relative,outcome=result['outcome'],reason=result['reason'],commands=len(result['commands']),samples=len(result['samples'])))
        target.write_bytes(body)
    check('native-runner-rejects-each-current-runtime-before-process',synthetic_observations=['resource availability','checkout cleanliness'],cases=native)
    # Rewrite each original archived source in isolation and consistently rehash
    # every source snapshot and retained descriptor. The externally supplied ZIP
    # digest is fresh too: source-pin enforcement must be the failure point.
    cases=[];mutant=tmp/'mutant.zip'
    for relative in sorted(c._SOURCE_HASHES):
        rewritten=dict(members);packet=copy.deepcopy(original_report)
        source_member='baseline/artifacts/source/'+relative
        changed=rewritten[source_member]+b'\n/* independent migration review mutation */\n'
        rewritten[source_member]=changed
        for key in ('source_before','source_after'):
            descriptor=packet[key];name='baseline/'+descriptor['path'];doc=json.loads(rewritten[name])
            for row in doc['files']+doc['checkout']['inputs']:
                if row['path']==relative:row.update(describe(relative,changed))
            rewritten[name]=encode(doc);packet[key]=describe(descriptor['path'],rewritten[name])
        for row in packet['retained_sources']:
            if row['path']=='artifacts/source/'+relative:row.update(describe(row['path'],changed))
        rewritten['baseline/report.json']=encode(packet)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(mutant,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=1) as z:
            for name,body in rewritten.items():z.writestr(name,body)
        digest=sha(mutant.read_bytes())
        reason=expect_error(lambda:replay.replay_archive(mutant,digest,expected_revision=index['source_revision'],expected_format='fp16'),'frozen source pin differs: '+relative)
        cases.append(dict(path=relative,rejection=reason,archive_sha256=digest))
    check('all46-rehashed-original-archive-substitutions-rejected',count=len(cases),cases=cases)
# Complete historical analysis from current trusted code, under process and
# extraction tripwires, compares measurement outputs with accepted originals.
with mock.patch.object(subprocess,'Popen',side_effect=AssertionError('no subprocess')),mock.patch.object(zipfile.ZipFile,'extract',side_effect=AssertionError('no extraction')),mock.patch.object(zipfile.ZipFile,'extractall',side_effect=AssertionError('no extraction')):
    result=analyze.analyze_archives(ROOT/archives['fp16']['path'],archives['fp16']['sha256'],ROOT/archives['bf16']['path'],archives['bf16']['sha256'],expected_revision=index['source_revision'])
saved=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/project/evidence/p06-baseline/reviews/analysis.json').read_text())
sections=('summary','diagnostics','metric_definitions','counter_null_policy','compatibility')
for section in sections:assert result[section]==saved[section],section
assert result['native_execution']=='not_run' and result['acceptance_claimed'] is False
check('original-full-analysis-under-no-execution-guards',compared_sections=list(sections),inventory=result['summary']['inventory'],native_execution=result['native_execution'])
report['source_after']=identities();assert report['source_before']==report['source_after']
report.update(outcome='pass',seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),source_stable=True)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'outcome':report['outcome'],'seconds':report['seconds'],'checks':len(report['checks']),'report':str(OUT)}),flush=True)
